title: Fold the missing pstack parts into Trace, Provenance sweep, the spike playbook and a design-sketch reference
action: Fold ONLY the parts bee does not have into existing homes (per D2 and D3). Never rename, re-level or delete an existing heading: pointer-integrity CI resolves cited headings. Never add a numeric limit the text does not already carry. Do NOT run bee dev regen (regen_obligation_ack wave-barrier). (1) skills/bee-researching/references/trace-and-provenance.md. Under '## Provenance sweep', after its report rules, add '### Confidence tiers' condensed from .claude/skills/why/references/epistemics.md: the five tiers Direct, Supported, Inferred, Speculative, Unknown, one or two sentences each with its phrasing rule ('because' and 'was designed to' only beside a citation; hedged words for an inference; the code is never evidence of its own intent; a user's guess in the question is one hypothesis, never the conclusion). Then add '### Provenance answer shape': What we found, What we can reasonably infer, Competing hypotheses, What we do not know, the seven category rows, a one-line confidence summary, and — when the why question precedes a change — a Preserve / Change / Avoid / Risk constraint set. Under '## Trace', after its closing anchor rule, add '### Trace answer shape' from .claude/skills/how/references/explainer-prompt.md: Overview, Key concepts, How it works (prose with path:line anchors; a diagram only when it clarifies), Where things live, Gotchas; drop any section that does not apply. The three new heading names are unique in the file. (2) skills/bee-planning/references/planning-reference.md, section '### spike': add one numbered step AFTER step 4 and before the sentence 'A spike that becomes the implementation was never a spike.', so no existing step renumbers and no new heading is added (a `### ` heading there must be a class value — class_playbook_parity.rs). The step, from .claude/skills/prototype/SKILL.md: when the question is which of several variants, build each under `.bee/spikes/<feature>/` behind one switcher with each variant labelled, observe each on the real surface (drive it with the project's own verification skill when it has one, otherwise log or print what you are deciding), and let the recorded answer name the chosen variant. (3) NEW skills/bee-planning/references/design-sketch.md (per D3), a reference only, no frontmatter. Open with one line saying when to load it: new code with an open shape on standard or high-risk work, several whole shapes viable, no pattern in the repo to copy; never for a bug fix, a rename, or a change with a pattern to copy. Then these sections, adapted from the local architect port and its three reference files: Caller's usage first (write the usage and two or three real call sites before the types, and derive the types from them); Sketch (types, signatures and module boundaries, with not-implemented bodies, written into the feature's plan files under docs/history/<feature>/ — never as source before the merged shape+execution gate); Candidates (when several whole shapes are viable, run blind lanes per `skills/bee-hive/references/gates-and-delegation.md` ("Blind lanes and convergence") — cite it, never copy its steps; the runner discipline from runner-prompt.md becomes the lanes' shared brief content); Design red flags (shallow module, information leakage, temporal decomposition, pass-through method, from design-red-flags.md); Rationale (the rationale template sections, with the synthesis decision taken from the blind-lane dossier's chosen answer and rejected set); Scrap tells (the pattern list from the port's Phase E; a scrap returns to bee-planning, and the old sketch is superseded through bee decisions log). The implementation itself runs in bee-swarming cells after the gate, against the sketch. Add one provenance line: Adapted from pstack (cursor/plugins, pstack/skills/architect). Every dispatch reads --runtime <rt>. (4) skills/bee-planning/SKILL.md: leave '## Research' untouched. In '## Shape', after the hat-wave sentence, add one sentence: When new code has an open shape on standard or high-risk work — several whole shapes viable and no pattern in the repo to copy — load `references/design-sketch.md` before the gate; the sketch lands in the plan, and the hat wave still runs as the plan check.
verify: rg -q '^### Confidence tiers' skills/bee-researching/references/trace-and-provenance.md && rg -q '^### Trace answer shape' skills/bee-researching/references/trace-and-provenance.md && rg -q '^### Provenance answer shape' skills/bee-researching/references/trace-and-provenance.md && rg -q '^## Trace$' skills/bee-researching/references/trace-and-provenance.md && rg -q '^## Provenance sweep$' skills/bee-researching/references/trace-and-provenance.md && test -s skills/bee-planning/references/design-sketch.md && rg -q 'design-sketch.md' skills/bee-planning/SKILL.md && rg -q 'switcher' skills/bee-planning/references/planning-reference.md && rg -q 'A spike that becomes the implementation was never a spike' skills/bee-planning/references/planning-reference.md && ! rg -n -e '--runtime claude' skills/bee-planning/references/design-sketch.md
